title: loopActivity
responsibility: Derives pending and total step counts, last activity and age, stale status, and human-readable loop summary lines.

inputs.name: openStepCount.state
inputs.description: Loop state whose pending steps are counted.

inputs.name: loopActivity.state
inputs.description: Loop state whose step counts and activity timestamps are summarized.

inputs.name: loopActivity.now
inputs.description: Current timestamp in ISO-compatible text used to calculate nonnegative age in whole days.

inputs.name: isStale.activity
inputs.description: Derived loop activity; unknown age is considered stale.

inputs.name: isStale.staleDays
inputs.description: Nonnegative idle-day threshold; the activity is stale when age is unknown or at least this many days.

inputs.name: loopSummaryLines.state
inputs.description: Loop whose activity and closure details are rendered.

inputs.name: loopSummaryLines.now
inputs.description: Current timestamp used to calculate displayed age.

outputs.name: openStepCount
outputs.description: Number of steps whose status is pending.

outputs.name: isOpenLoop
outputs.description: True only when the loop is not closed and has at least one pending step.

outputs.name: loopActivity
outputs.description: Pending and total step counts plus last activity and age when valid timestamps are available.

outputs.name: isStale
outputs.description: Whether activity is unknown or its whole-day age meets the threshold.

outputs.name: loopSummaryLines
outputs.description: Human-readable age, open-step counts, and closure reason lines.
